scope: 时钟、原作菜单、地区地图与默认分支Pages

runs.label: workflow-yaml
command: require "yaml"; w=YAML.load_file(".github/workflows/checks.yml"); raise "Missing publish gate" unless w["jobs"]["publish"]["needs"] == "verify"; raise "Missing branch gate" unless w["jobs"]["publish"]["if"].include?("repository.default_branch"); puts "Workflow YAML parsed; publish requires verification and default branch"

manualVerification: not recorded; check results do not establish visual/audio fidelity

boundaryReview.basis: whole working tree against HEAD; includes pre-existing work outside this batch
boundaryReview.note: Cross-layer edits require a stated capability or defect; file count alone does not prove a violation
